name: Sandcrab
description: Sandcrabs are desert insectoids able to survive for extraordinary periods without water. They burrow beneath the dunes, erupt beneath prey and attack in sudden, coordinated swarms.
story: In the Ddiddiwedht Desert, the ground itself has claws.
lore: A sandcrab's plated body is carried on powerful legs and crowned by a long horn. One is manageable; a colony rising from beneath a traveler's feet can strip the flesh from the unprepared before the dust settles.
dangerLevel: Moderate in isolation; high in swarms
